board.notes: The board reads as a dark reflective plane — pieces mirror faintly in the surface.

description: Faction material law for the cinematic chess rebuild. Black army: black obsidian armor with gold filigree. White army: ivory armor with gold detail. Gold filigree appears on every piece in both armies.

Black.cape: Dark cape, near-black with gold clasp
Black.notes: Obsidian reads near-black with depth; gold filigree traces every armor edge.

White.cape: Light cape, ivory with gold clasp
White.notes: Ivory reads warm white; gold trim is restrained next to the black army's filigree.

globalRules: Gold filigree or gold trim appears on ALL pieces in both armies.
No plastic or toon shading anywhere — PBR photoreal materials only.
Cape cloth uses the same faction palette, never a third color.
Weapon metals match the faction material set.
Board stays dark reflective in every lighting scenario.
